svg.title: Harness layers around the raw LLM
svg.desc: The agent harness sits between the application and the LLM. Its execution loop, prompt assembler, state manager, and observer handle everything except reasoning. The loop calls tools in both directions, the prompt assembler sends the assembled prompt to the model, the state manager checkpoints after each step, and the observer logs every step.

text.tspan: Logs every step by run ID

svg.text: // HARNESS LAYERS AROUND THE RAW LLM
